See", "        :ref:`sphx_glr_auto_examples_developing_estimators_sklearn_is_fitted.py`", "        for an example on how to use the API.", "    ", "        If no `attributes` are passed, this function will pass if an estimator is stateless.", "        An estimator can indicate it's stateless by setting the `requires_fit` tag.
